spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background, standing low to the ground in a walking pose. It has a stout, elongated body with a pale pink, wrinkled, fleshy underside, throat, limbs and tail underside, and a broad, rounded head with a blunt snout. The entire dorsal surface from the back of the head to the tip of the long tapering tail is covered in large, overlapping, brown to gray-brown keratinous scales with darker edges and paler centers arranged in diagonal rows. Behind the head on both sides are prominent pink external gills with feathery red filaments. It stands on four thick, fleshy legs with clawed feet, and has small dark eyes and a closed mouth giving a slight smile.
